title: Hezbollah Claims 22 Attacks on Israeli Forces in Southern Lebanon as Washington Talks Continue
detail: Hezbollah claimed 22 separate attacks on Israeli forces operating in southern Lebanon on May 29, according to Middle East Eye, as Washington security talks between Lebanese and Israeli delegations continued at the Pentagon. The wave of claimed operations underscores the continued armed friction on the ground despite ongoing diplomatic negotiations over IDF withdrawal timelines, Lebanese Armed Forces deployment, and Hezbollah disarmament south of the Litani River. The attacks span multiple engagement types targeting Israeli military positions in the occupied southern border zone.

media.caption: Destroyed building in Tyre, southern Lebanon, amid ongoing Hezbollah-Israel hostilities
